scope: scripts/record-stabilization-evidence.mjs and tests/unit/stabilization-evidence.test.ts; no browser or heavy test run by this reviewer
accepted_source_properties: Guard and result SHA-256 values are computed from independently read file bytes rather than caller-supplied digests; the two source paths must resolve to distinct files.
The guard parser requires exactly one RESOURCE_ADMITTED and one RESOURCE_JOB_EXIT with the requested run ID, rejecting the observed Debug 006 log when asked to record Screenshot 001.
The writer uses exclusive create with mode 0600 and cannot overwrite an existing receipt or either source file.
Raw child stdout and arbitrary result fields are not copied into the record; the test independently recomputes both digests and checks private fixture strings are absent.

resolved_findings.original_problem: A child exit 0 could coexist with a later wrapper cleanup failure.
resolved_findings.repair_evidence: The parser now refuses RESOURCE_OWNED_PROCESS_STILL_RUNNING, RESOURCE_GROUP_STILL_RUNNING, RESOURCE_GROUP_UNCONFIRMED, and RESOURCE_STOP_AT_SAFE_BOUNDARY. A test places owned-process failure after child exit 0 and requires refusal before output creation. The output separately labels wrapper completion unverified from the guard log and overall acceptance not adjudicated.

resolved_findings.original_problem: A nonzero child exit could coexist with a raw pass without any classified contradiction.
resolved_findings.repair_evidence: The generator now rejects nonzero child exit paired with raw pass, before output creation; the new test covers that exact contradiction. A nonzero child with raw fail remains representable and is explicitly classified child_exit=nonzero with no overall acceptance claim.

regression_review: The repair does not change digest computation from actual bytes, distinct realpath checks, private payload omission, or exclusive mode-0600 output creation. The fixed output shape still excludes child stdout and arbitrary private result fields.
bounded_metadata_note: Source paths and valid build-version strings are still not length-bounded. Use only intended evidence paths; the correction records provenance and does not claim overall run acceptance.
next_step: Await the root-owned guarded unit result, then generate a separate Screenshot 001 correction without modifying the original receipt.
